'''Susan Galloway Hilsenbeck''' is an American [[biostatistics|biostatistician]] whose research interests include [[biomarker]]s and the applications of biostatistics in [[cancer]] research. She is a professor in the [[Baylor College of Medicine]], where she directs the Quantitative Sciences Share Resource in the Dan L. Duncan Comprehensive Cancer Center.{{r|bcm}}

Hilsenbeck earned her Ph.D. in 1990, at the [[University of Miami]].{{r|bcm}} Her dissertation, ''Acquisition and use of information on data quality in large population-based tumor registries'', was supervised by Charles Kurucz.{{r|diss}} She was elected as a [[Fellow of the American Statistical Association]] in 2011.{{r|fasa}}

Her hobbies include [[scuba diving]] and [[quilting]].{{r|not}} Her quilts have been featured in the books ''Amish Quilts, The Adventure Continues'' (2013){{r|aq}} and ''Quarantine Quilts: Creativity in the Midst of Chaos'' (2021).{{r|qq}}
